_comment: One entry per lexicon sense. Antonymy belongs to a sense, not to a word: right opposes left as a direction and wrong as a judgement. A core function word may appear with an empty concept, since it names nothing but up against down is still a pair a level-one reader wants. An uncovered sense is a violation; an entry with no antonym is not, because most nouns oppose nothing. This is an analysis tool during authoring and level-one reference material afterwards. See docs/decisions/LEXICON.md.
